verdict.rationale: Mercury's docs explicitly direct AI agents to https://docs.mercury.com/llms.txt, an index of all pages in Markdown plus endpoints in OpenAPI, and any doc page can be fetched as Markdown by appending .md. A probe confirmed llms.txt returns HTTP 200, many cited .md doc URLs resolve, and an official Agent Skills repo adds agent-oriented SKILL.md guidance. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of an agent consuming the docs, and an OpenAPI spec at a standard discoverable path (common candidate paths returned 404).
